statement: Stock xpad advertises four distinct Elite Series 2 EV_KEY capabilities BTN_GRIPR, BTN_GRIPR2, BTN_GRIPL and BTN_GRIPL2, together with its Xbox One ordinary buttons, ABS_X/Y/RX/RY signed 16-bit sticks (fuzz 16, flat 128), ABS_Z/RZ triggers ranging 0 to 1023 and ABS_HAT0X/Y. Elite product 0x0b00 does not enable the standard Series KEY_RECORD Share capability.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: xpad.c:459-475, 1905-1925, 1973-2025; advertised xpad evdev shape only, independent of actual paddle events.
